item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will affect the coast of western Guangdong tomorrow. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve and will be very hot over Guangdong from the latter part of this week to early next week. The area of low pressure now over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone and intensify gradually. There are large uncertainties in its subsequent movement. It is more likely that it will enter the northern part of the South China Sea early next week, bringing unsettled weather to the coast of southern China. However, the tropical cyclone may move towards the vicinity of Taiwan instead.
